ai_rules: PURE_UI_COMPONENTS: React components must separate UI rendering from business logic (CardPointe fetch logic).
STRICT_TYPING: All new props and state must have explicit TypeScript interfaces. No 'any'.
TAILWIND_ISOLATION: Do not use inline styles for structural layouts. Always use Tailwind utility classes.
SECURITY_PCI: Never store raw credit card data or PANs in React state or localStorage.
